subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.html@5` is this plugin's own self-contained HTML5 document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-doctype, insert-node, remove-node, set-element-name, set-attribute, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
